name: mirage
text: Built: the Tracker's Stats page now has a Yesterday chip and a Pick day chip. Pick day opens a calendar; choose any date and it shows that day's profit/loss, record and the running-profit chart, same as Today. Yesterday works the same way. Days are game days, Eastern, 5 am to 5 am. It comes out in the next release (v1.0.9), which also carries the thin-books guard; I'm shipping it now.
